slides.title: Unordered Containers Concept
slides.prompt: Unordered containers (std::unordered_map, std::unordered_set) implement hash tables. They provide average O(1) constant-time search, insertion, and deletion.

slides.title: Header for Unordered Map
slides.prompt: Fill in the header file required for std::unordered_map.

slides.title: Average vs Worst Complexity
slides.prompt: What are the average and worst-case search time complexities for std::unordered_map?
options: Average: O(1), Worst-Case: O(N) when hash collisions occur frequently
slides.correctAnswer: Average: O(1), Worst-Case: O(N) when hash collisions occur frequently

slides.title: Bucket Count Check
slides.prompt: Fill in the method returning the current number of hash table buckets.

slides.title: Requirements for Custom Key Types
slides.prompt: What two items must be supplied to use a custom class as a key in std::unordered_map?
options: A hash function (std::hash specialization or custom functor) AND an equality comparison operator (operator==)
A less-than operator (operator<) AND an assignment operator
A default constructor AND a destructor only
A virtual function table AND serializing functions
slides.correctAnswer: A hash function (std::hash specialization or custom functor) AND an equality comparison operator (operator==)

slides.title: Load Factor Method
slides.prompt: Fill in the method returning the average number of elements per bucket.

slides.title: Rehash Trigger Condition
slides.prompt: When does an unordered container trigger a automatic rehash operation?
options: Whenever a duplicate key is searched

slides.title: Manual Rehash
slides.prompt: Fill in the method used to manually set the minimum bucket count and rehash the table.

slides.title: Ordered vs Unordered Map Iteration
slides.prompt: Which statement correctly describes iteration order in std::unordered_map?
options: Elements are traversed in an arbitrary order dictated by hash values and bucket allocation
Elements are guaranteed to be sorted by key ascending
Elements are iterated in the exact order they were inserted
Elements are sorted by value descending
slides.correctAnswer: Elements are traversed in an arbitrary order dictated by hash values and bucket allocation

slides.title: Checking Bucket of Key
slides.prompt: Fill in the method returning the bucket index assigned to a specific key.
